verses.html: Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; and to which of the saints wilt thou turn?
verses.text: Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; and to which of the saints wilt thou turn?

verses.html: For wrath killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one.
verses.text: For wrath killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one.

verses.html: I have seen the foolish taking root: but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
verses.text: I have seen the foolish taking root: but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

verses.html: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, neither is there any to deliver them.
verses.text: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, neither is there any to deliver them.

verses.html: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.
verses.text: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.

verses.html: Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;
verses.text: Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;

verses.html: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
verses.text: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

verses.html: I would seek unto God, and unto God would I commit my cause:
verses.text: I would seek unto God, and unto God would I commit my cause:

verses.html: Which doeth great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:
verses.text: Which doeth great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:

verses.html: Who giveth rain upon the earth, and sendeth waters upon the fields:
verses.text: Who giveth rain upon the earth, and sendeth waters upon the fields:

verses.html: To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.
verses.text: To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.

verses.html: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.
verses.text: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.

verses.html: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.
verses.text: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.

verses.html: They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.
verses.text: They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.

verses.html: But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.
verses.text: But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.

verses.html: So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.
verses.text: So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.

verses.html: Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:
verses.text: Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:

verses.html: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.
verses.text: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.

verses.html: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.
verses.text: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.

verses.html: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.
verses.text: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.

verses.html: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.
verses.text: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.

verses.html: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.
verses.text: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.

verses.html: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.
verses.text: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.

verses.html: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle shall be in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.
verses.text: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle shall be in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.

verses.html: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, and thine offspring as the grass of the earth.
verses.text: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, and thine offspring as the grass of the earth.

verses.html: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.
verses.text: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.

verses.html: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know thou it for thy good.
verses.text: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know thou it for thy good.
